title: ALS trial facts: selected publication and sponsor-report extracts
license_scope: Original factual selection, structure, and summaries: CC BY 4.0. Source publications and sponsor content retain their own rights. No abstracts, full papers, patient records, individual contact details, or licensed datasets are redistributed.

provenance.method: Manual factual extraction from fetched primary-publication abstracts and an inspected official sponsor release; values transcribed without estimating missing results.
provenance.registry_status_limit: ClinicalTrials.gov API retrieval through the provided skill was blocked by an unavailable shared dependency; ordinary study HTML returned only an application shell. No current registry fields are inferred.
provenance.response_hash_note: SHA-256 values fingerprint the inspected response bytes, not source truth or a promise that a later response will match. Raw source responses were retained outside the repository during drafting.
provenance.selection_limit: Four purposefully selected historical records illustrate changing evidence and research design; this is not a systematic ALS trial catalog or a clinical guideline.
provenance.review_limit: AI factual extraction; qualified scientific and clinical review pending.
provenance.source_field_map: Each record maps its factual fields to source section labels in field_provenance.

records.title: Randomized tofersen study in symptomatic SOD1-associated ALS

design.masking: Not extracted from the abstract used for this row; not a registry assertion.

records.population: Adults with ALS associated with SOD1 variants; the primary analysis used the subgroup predicted to progress faster.
records.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in ALSFRS-R total score in the predicted-faster-progression subgroup.

primary_result.analysis_note: The primary test did not reach statistical significance. The reported P value belongs to the trial's specified analysis; do not recompute it from rounded means or this confidence interval. Higher ALSFRS-R scores represent better function.

limitations: This is the 2022 28-week randomized result, not all subsequent tofersen evidence.
The clinical primary endpoint did not meet significance despite biomarker reductions.
The small faster-progression primary subgroup differs from the overall randomized population.
Later delayed-start/open-label follow-up must be labeled separately and not treated as 28-week placebo-controlled evidence.
No treatment recommendation, dosing guidance, reversal of ALS, or cure claim is implied.
records.registry_status_note: Not queried; factual results extracted from a publication abstract, not a registry snapshot.

records.title: Sodium phenylbutyrate–taurursodiol phase 2 randomized study
records.population: Participants with definite ALS whose symptoms began within the previous 18 months.
records.primary_endpoint: Rate of change of ALSFRS-R total score through the randomized study period.

primary_result.measure: Difference in mean ALSFRS-R rate of change
primary_result.analysis_note: Modified intention-to-treat analysis. This is a slope difference per month, not the 24-week point difference and not a survival estimate. Secondary outcomes were not statistically different in this report.

limitations: Read with the later negative PHOENIX trial row; the early finding is not a current effectiveness or availability recommendation.
Randomized enrollment counts are not asserted to equal the modified-intention-to-treat analysis denominators.
Do not multiply the slope difference by a rough weeks-to-months conversion and report it as a newly verified trial endpoint.
The 2020 report predates subsequent confirmatory evidence and U.S. approval withdrawal.
No cure, individual response, or long-term survival result follows from this primary endpoint alone.
records.registry_status_note: Not queried; factual results extracted from a publication abstract, not a registry snapshot.

records.title: Confirmatory phase 3 AMX0035 trial in ALS

design.control: placebo with standard-of-care in both groups
design.masking: Not extracted from the release used for this row.

records.population: Adults living with ALS in a global trial.
records.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in ALSFRS-R total score.

primary_result.measure: Primary between-group comparison of ALSFRS-R total-score change
primary_result.analysis_note: The sponsor reported no statistically significant difference in the primary endpoint or secondary endpoints. The release did not supply an effect estimate or confidence interval; these are not inferred from the P value.

limitations: Source is a sponsor topline release dated 2024-03-08, not an independent review or a current registry status check.
The release's historical statements on product availability are not repeated as current advice.
The allocation ratio does not establish exact per-group enrollment counts, so those counts are not invented.
An insignificant result does not mathematically establish identical outcomes, zero effect, or absence of adverse effects.
U.S. formal approval withdrawal and later evidence must be read from dated regulatory and scientific sources separately.
records.registry_status_note: Not queried; a sponsor release supplies these dated study facts. No current recruitment or registry status is asserted.

records.title: Presymptomatic tofersen trial design in selected SOD1 variant carriers
records.population: Clinically presymptomatic carriers of SOD1 variants associated with high or complete penetrance and rapid progression, selected additionally for elevated plasma neurofilament light chain.
records.primary_endpoint: Whether earlier tofersen delays emergence of clinically manifest ALS; this is the design abstract's stated study objective, not a copied registered primary-outcome definition.
limitations: A design article does not provide efficacy results or demonstrate ALS prevention.
Actual enrollment, exact registered endpoint definition, endpoint time frame, and current trial status were not retrieved.
This selection criterion does not apply to all SOD1 carriers or all forms of ALS.
A linked 2022 correction was identified, but its text was not available from the fetched record. Confirm the corrected full protocol before reusing design details.
No genetic screening or presymptomatic treatment advice is given.
records.registry_status_note: Not queried; this row describes the 2022 design abstract only.
